technique: Standardized transfer protocol with closed exception list and statutory clocks
problem_addressed: Bespoke, slow, adversarial account moves where the losing firm controls timing
evidence: Carrying firm must validate or take exception within 1 business day and complete within 3 business days of validation; exceptions only from an enumerated list; standard forms.
unbound_design_implication: Define a closed MigrationIntakeException code set (e.g. DUPLICATE_SOURCE_ID, FUND_BALANCE_MISMATCH, ORPHAN_GRANT, UNKNOWN_RECIPIENT_EIN, MISSING_ADVISOR_AUTHORITY, UNSUPPORTED_ASSET) with a deterministic resolution path each; anything not on the list is a defect in Unbound tooling, not a consulting task. Caveat (adversarial review ADVB-02/03): ACATS works because FINRA compels the losing firm; no DAF rule compels an incumbent, so clocks apply only to Unbound-side steps and the receiving-side pattern for sponsor-to-sponsor transfers (UNB-XIN-EVA-009) cannot bind the source sponsor.

technique: Switching service with published guarantee, fixed duration and redirection
industry_origin: UK retail banking (Current Account Switch Service)
problem_addressed: Customer fear that payments will be lost; incumbents' inertia advantage
evidence: 7-working-day switch on a chosen date; new provider moves incoming/outgoing payments, redirects misdirected payments and contacts the sender; refunds interest/charges on failure; 1.19m switches in 2024, 99.7% within 7 working days; 160.5m payments redirected over 11+ years.
unbound_design_implication: Publish an Unbound Migration Service Commitment limited to Unbound-controlled steps (clock starts at receipt of a conforming extract; source-side delays excluded): sponsor-chosen cutover date, bounded Unbound-side freeze, every in-flight item owned, legacy-reference crosswalk (old fund/grant/check/payee IDs) for >=36 months extended until 13 months without hits, service credits for Unbound-caused detriment. CASS relies on scheme rules binding both banks; DAF has no equivalent, so no CASS-equivalence claim. Unbound redirects references, never funds (CNV-LEG-001).

technique: Advance blackout notice with content rules and a short-freeze threshold
problem_addressed: Participants surprised by recordkeeper conversion freezes
evidence: Notice 30-60 days before a restriction exceeding 3 consecutive business days; must state reasons, rights affected, expected dates, contact.
unbound_design_implication: Upgrades UNB-XIN-OTH-002 (which cited 401(k) practice as 'unverified'): the analogue is a real regulation. Adopt 30-60 day TransitionWindow notice; design target: donor-facing write freeze <=3 business days, grant recommendations accepted and queued throughout.

technique: Single issuer of annual tax reporting for the cutover year, combining predecessor data
industry_origin: US payroll (Rev. Proc. 2004-53 alternate procedure; payroll-provider switching)
problem_addressed: Duplicate or split year-end forms; YTD balances lost on mid-year switch
evidence: Successor may assume the predecessor's entire W-2 obligation, reporting wages of both; payroll providers require YTD/QTD history and proof of tax payments and warn only one provider should issue W-2s.
unbound_design_implication: For a mid-year sponsor migration, exactly one system (configurable, default Unbound) issues the year's donor statements and contribution acknowledgment summaries and Schedule D aggregates, using imported YTD contribution/grant history; imported acknowledgments are flagged as-issued and never re-issued (runbook M18).

technique: Repeated full-volume dress rehearsals with timed cutover
problem_addressed: Unknown cutover duration and late-discovered defects
evidence: CBA planned three dress rehearsals and ran five; 8-hour target window; fully offline three hours; 16m active accounts (company self-report).
unbound_design_implication: Require >=3 full mock conversions of Unbound's transform, using as many fresh source extracts as the sponsor's Extraction Plan permits (min 1, else synthetic deltas); go/no-go needs the last two rehearsals to reconcile with zero unexplained breaks and finish inside the cutover window with margin.

technique: Production-equivalent non-functional testing and evidence-based readiness attestations
problem_addressed: Configuration/capacity defects invisible in reduced-scope testing
evidence: Testing compressed and run in parallel to meet dates; concluded the day before the migrate decision; Active-Active testing descoped; readiness attestations shifted between functions without challenge.
unbound_design_implication: Readiness evidence is machine-produced (test run IDs, reconciliation reports), not signed letters; a minimum quiet period between last passing rehearsal and the cutover decision; capacity test at sponsor's peak (December) volume.

technique: Migration in waves/transition groups with early low-risk cohorts
problem_addressed: Big-bang risk across millions of accounts
evidence: Schwab converted ~$1.9T and >17m accounts in five transition groups, attrition below initial estimates; Nordea moved product-by-product (e.g. ~250,000 Finnish savings accounts first).
unbound_design_implication: Wave across sponsors (first sponsors small and simple), not across funds within one sponsor's book of record: a sponsor ledger should have one authoritative writer (RR-REQ-X-061-r1). Within a sponsor, phase non-ledger surfaces (advisor SSO, statements) if needed.

technique: Old-to-new identifier mapping file returned to customer
industry_origin: Payments (Stripe PAN import); CRM (Salesforce external IDs)
problem_addressed: Broken references after migration; duplicate objects
evidence: Stripe returns CSV/JSON mapping of previous processor IDs to new IDs; Salesforce recommends legacy IDs stored in indexed External ID fields for relationships and validation reports.
unbound_design_implication: Every migrated entity keeps (source_system, source_record_id) as an immutable alternate key; Unbound publishes a mapping artifact per migration run; legacy IDs remain searchable in donor/charity/advisor UIs and APIs.

technique: Encrypted, attested data handoff between regulated holders
industry_origin: Payments (PCI DSS processor-to-processor card data portability)
problem_addressed: Losing processor slow-walks export; security of bulk sensitive data
evidence: Receiving processor provides PCI AOC and PGP key; sender encrypts and uploads via SFTP; exports can take days to months; contracts may oblige release on request.
unbound_design_implication: Inbound: accept sponsor-signed, encrypted packages with manifest and record extraction_method (incumbent will usually not sign or cooperate; extraction relies on the sponsor's data-ownership rights per an Extraction Plan). Outbound: Unbound contracts state export format and maximum export time and deliver to any successor.

technique: Ramp traffic after a merchant-identity change
problem_addressed: Issuers decline transactions from an unfamiliar merchant ID
evidence: Stripe warns new MID may cause temporary declines; recommends ramping volume and sending highest-quality traffic first.
unbound_design_implication: INFERENCE: charities/banks may reject or query payments from an unfamiliar originator name/ID. Keep the sponsor's ACH Company Name/ID stable across the platform change where the ODFI allows, pre-notify charities, and release first post-cutover grants through networked partner rails already known to the charity.

technique: Mandatory self-service full-population export in a published format
industry_origin: Healthcare IT (ONC §170.315(b)(10) EHI export, 21st Century Cures)
problem_addressed: Vendor lock-in through proprietary or assisted-only exports
evidence: Certified health IT must export all EHI for a patient and for a population, computable, with a public link to the format, without developer assistance.
unbound_design_implication: Make exit symmetric with entry as Unbound's own contractual exit terms: unassisted export of the whole sponsor in the same published Migration Package format, no export fee, never conditional on payment, onboarding-cost recovery only via a published declining schedule (ADVB-11). Contrast with public incumbent terms (paid PS export, deletion after exit; ADVB-02).

technique: Async bulk export with incremental (_since) deltas
problem_addressed: Large extracts that time out; re-extracting everything for each rehearsal
evidence: Kick-off returns 202 + status URL; NDJSON files per resource type; _since returns resources changed after a timestamp; SMART backend auth.
unbound_design_implication: Source-system adapters should support full + delta extraction so rehearsal N+1 and the final cutover only move changes since the last validated snapshot, shrinking the freeze window.

technique: Standard identity provisioning and federation instead of credential migration
problem_addressed: Recreating users and permissions by hand; password migration
evidence: SCIM: HTTP protocol for provisioning identities across domains, bulk operations, intent to reduce cost and complexity of user management.
unbound_design_implication: Advisor firms connect via OIDC/SAML with SCIM or JIT provisioning; donor credentials are not migrated (re-enrolment with risk-based proofing per CNV-PLT-003); advisor authorities are migrated as data and re-confirmed (runbook M07).

technique: Landing zone / reference environment built before migrating workloads
problem_addressed: Each migration re-deciding foundations
evidence: AWS guidance: mobilize phase implements the landing zone; migrate phase reuses patterns and tools defined and tested in mobilize.
unbound_design_implication: A sponsor tenant is provisioned declaratively (CNV-ARC-005) from a reference sponsor configuration before any data arrives; migration only fills data, never shapes infrastructure.

technique: Foundation tenant and configuration-not-customization
problem_addressed: Per-customer design from a blank page; custom code that blocks upgrades
evidence: Workday deployments start from a foundation tenant baseline; optimization through product updates and configuration, not customization (vendor docs).
unbound_design_implication: Ship a reference policy pack and chart of accounts per segment (national, single-issue, advisor-distributed per CNV-ECO-004); a sponsor declares deltas as versioned config (CNV-GOV-005); no sponsor-specific code paths.

technique: Dependency-ordered loads with deferred derived computations
problem_addressed: Slow loads and lock contention from recomputing derived data per record
evidence: Load parents before children; defer sharing calculations until data loaded.
unbound_design_implication: Import into non-authoritative staging, then post opening balances and history in dependency order (sponsor > fund > participant/authority > contribution > grant > payment); rebuild projections once at the end rather than per record.

technique: Golden dataset conformance suite for every source adapter
industry_origin: Cross-industry practice (test fixtures); daf-landscape migration runbook
problem_addressed: Each legacy source mapped ad hoc by consultants
evidence: Internal runbook defines a universal synthetic fixture (2 sponsors, 5 years, edge states). No external source found quantifying benefit.
unbound_design_implication: Each supported legacy source (e.g. Ren, iPhi, FIMS/CommunitySuite exports) gets an adapter certified against the synthetic golden fixture plus a sponsor-specific stratified golden sample verified by sponsor finance.

technique: Deterministic, replayable ETL (pure mapping functions, versioned)
industry_origin: Data engineering practice; Thought Machine/AWS logic-extraction claims
problem_addressed: Non-reproducible conversions; cannot explain a break
evidence: No primary quantitative evidence found; vendor claims (Thought Machine/AWS) emphasise extracting logic into specifications with human sign-off gates.
unbound_design_implication: Mapping = pure function(source snapshot hash, mapping version, policy version) -> staging snapshot hash; rerun must be byte-identical; every staging row carries lineage; AI may propose mappings only (CNV-AIO-001).

technique: Reconciliation gates with control totals
industry_origin: Accounting/ERP opening-balance practice; TSB, Revlon negative lessons
problem_addressed: Go-live with unreconciled balances; control weaknesses after ERP change
evidence: Revlon disclosed a material weakness primarily related to ERP implementation; ERP practice validates trial balance as of migration date.
unbound_design_implication: Gate cutover on tie-out by fund, position, period and pending payment (RR-REQ-X-061-r1) plus annual control totals of contributions and grants for every imported year; detailed gate design belongs to MIG deliverables 13-17.

technique: Parallel run (shadow) before cutover
problem_addressed: Undetected calculation differences at go-live
evidence: Press reports that the vendor recommended keeping a parallel pay system and this was largely ignored.
unbound_design_implication: Use a shadow-replay of one or more closed periods (fees, unitization, statements) against legacy outputs rather than a live dual-write parallel run; dual live writers are prohibited (RR-REQ-X-061-r1).

technique: Industry-mandated common API standard
industry_origin: Open banking (UK CMA Order 2017; US CFPB §1033)
problem_addressed: Screen-scraping and bespoke integrations per institution
evidence: CMA required the nine largest UK providers to implement common standards; all completed by Sept 2024. CFPB §1033 rule finalized Oct 2024 and under reconsideration (ANPR Aug 2025).
unbound_design_implication: No DAF regulator mandates portability and there is no central utility; Unbound can only lead by publishing an open, permissively licensed Migration Package schema and inviting other vendors, sponsors and charity networks to adopt it (adoption is HYPOTHESIS) (see direction-data-standards-interoperability). Do not depend on §1033 for DAF data: applicability to DAF accounts is not established.

technique: Outsourcing a closed book to a specialist administrator
problem_addressed: Cost of keeping legacy platforms alive for decades
evidence: Consultancies describe outsourcing closed blocks and rule extraction before migration; long-lived policies (20-40 years).
unbound_design_implication: Weak analogy: a sponsor exiting a legacy platform may leave archived history in a read-only archive instead of converting it; Unbound should support importing as-issued legacy statements as documents linked to funds when full transactional history is uneconomic, labelled as such.

technique: Logic extraction to specifications with human sign-off (AI-assisted migration)
problem_addressed: Product logic embedded in legacy databases
evidence: Vendor release claims multi-year processes compressed into days; no figures or customer results.
unbound_design_implication: AI may extract fee schedules, grant policies and statement rules from legacy documents into draft policy-pack config for human approval (CNV-AIO-001/002); never authoritative.

technique: Exactly-one-writer fencing at cutover
problem_addressed: Dual writes create unreconcilable divergence
evidence: Already specified in Unbound (legacy writer fenced before Unbound posts; post-fence legacy write = incident).
unbound_design_implication: No change; cite as existing control (RR-REQ-X-061-r1, DKS-ENT-019).
